units.rawText: A few minutes ago, Enigma Sector.
units.displayText: A few minutes ago, Enigma Sector.

spans.text: A few minutes ago, Enigma Sector.

units.rawText: BOOM!
units.displayText: BOOM!

spans.text: BOOM!

units.rawText: With a great crash, another wall crumbles, the destroyed building dissipating into operands.
units.displayText: With a great crash, another wall crumbles, the destroyed building dissipating into operands.

spans.text: With a great crash, another wall crumbles, the destroyed building dissipating into operands.

units.rawText: Overtime... overtime here again. Shouldn't such urgent matters be resolved as soon as possible?
units.displayText: Overtime... overtime here again. Shouldn't such urgent matters be resolved as soon as possible?

spans.text: Overtime... overtime here again. Shouldn't such urgent matters be resolved as soon as possible?

units.rawText: Sigh, tell me, little Eucharist, how did things turn out like this?
units.displayText: Sigh, tell me, little Eucharist, how did things turn out like this?

spans.text: Sigh, tell me, little Eucharist, how did things turn out like this?

units.rawText: Eh? What are you saying, Angelus?
units.displayText: Eh? What are you saying, Angelus?

spans.text: Eh? What are you saying, Angelus?

units.rawText: This was work you were supposed to do in the first place, and you failed to meet the deadline, so it's natural that you'd have to make up for it, right?
units.displayText: This was work you were supposed to do in the first place, and you failed to meet the deadline, so it's natural that you'd have to make up for it, right?

spans.text: This was work you were supposed to do in the first place, and you failed to meet the deadline, so it's natural that you'd have to make up for it, right?

units.rawText: If I didn't come along, would you have wanted to simply let this fly, and allow the Irregular Agents to do as they please?
units.displayText: If I didn't come along, would you have wanted to simply let this fly, and allow the Irregular Agents to do as they please?

spans.text: If I didn't come along, would you have wanted to simply let this fly, and allow the Irregular Agents to do as they please?

units.rawText: So what if everyone just did as they pleased... an agent's life shouldn't be nothing but struggle, you know.
units.displayText: So what if everyone just did as they pleased... an agent's life shouldn't be nothing but struggle, you know.

spans.text: So what if everyone just did as they pleased... an agent's life shouldn't be nothing but struggle, you know.

units.rawText: What?
units.displayText: What?

spans.text: What?

units.rawText: The purpose of our existence is to fight in the name of our mission! What do you under—
units.displayText: The purpose of our existence is to fight in the name of our mission! What do you under—

spans.text: The purpose of our existence is to fight in the name of our mission! What do you under—

units.rawText: Uh, excuse me, please, can you two beautiful, mighty, elegant, exquisite, cute, and fine ladies wait for a second!
units.displayText: Uh, excuse me, please, can you two beautiful, mighty, elegant, exquisite, cute, and fine ladies wait for a second!

spans.text: Uh, excuse me, please, can you two beautiful, mighty, elegant, exquisite, cute, and fine ladies wait for a second!

units.rawText: Revered Lady Eucharist, Lady Angelus, may you lower your weapons and hear me out?
units.displayText: Revered Lady Eucharist, Lady Angelus, may you lower your weapons and hear me out?

spans.text: Revered Lady Eucharist, Lady Angelus, may you lower your weapons and hear me out?

units.rawText: Neumann? Huh, good timing. Failure to report Irregular Agent activity last time, and obstruction of justice now.
units.displayText: Neumann? Huh, good timing. Failure to report Irregular Agent activity last time, and obstruction of justice now.

spans.text: Neumann? Huh, good timing. Failure to report Irregular Agent activity last time, and obstruction of justice now.

units.rawText: Tell me, hmm? Pray tell, how should I punish you?
units.displayText: Tell me, hmm? Pray tell, how should I punish you?

spans.text: Tell me, hmm? Pray tell, how should I punish you?

units.rawText: Oh, please believe me, I have no intent to get in the way of your official proceedings. I simply think that there might be a few misunderstandings at hand...
units.displayText: Oh, please believe me, I have no intent to get in the way of your official proceedings. I simply think that there might be a few misunderstandings at hand...

spans.text: Oh, please believe me, I have no intent to get in the way of your official proceedings. I simply think that there might be a few misunderstandings at hand...

units.rawText: The striking Irregular Agent's name is ENIAC, yes?
units.displayText: The striking Irregular Agent's name is ENIAC, yes?

spans.text: The striking Irregular Agent's name is ENIAC, yes?

units.rawText: Eucharist's expression became serious and harsh.
units.displayText: Eucharist's expression became serious and harsh.

spans.text: Eucharist's expression became serious and harsh.

units.rawText: Hand her over, or this matter won't be as mild as taking down a few firewalls!
units.displayText: Hand her over, or this matter won't be as mild as taking down a few firewalls!

spans.text: Hand her over, or this matter won't be as mild as taking down a few firewalls!

units.rawText: ...Ladies, please do not commit such cruel acts.
units.displayText: ...Ladies, please do not commit such cruel acts.

spans.text: ...Ladies, please do not commit such cruel acts.

units.rawText: Neumann trembled, jaw tightening and foothold firm.
units.displayText: Neumann trembled, jaw tightening and foothold firm.

spans.text: Neumann trembled, jaw tightening and foothold firm.

units.rawText: You refuse? No matter. When the Upright Babylon Tower's judgment arrives, perhaps I will be responsible for adjudicating your sins.
units.displayText: You refuse? No matter. When the Upright Babylon Tower's judgment arrives, perhaps I will be responsible for adjudicating your sins.

spans.text: You refuse? No matter. When the Upright Babylon Tower's judgment arrives, perhaps I will be responsible for adjudicating your sins.

units.rawText: Surely not, little Eucharist, not a second round of overtime?
units.displayText: Surely not, little Eucharist, not a second round of overtime?

spans.text: Surely not, little Eucharist, not a second round of overtime?

units.rawText: Angelus, if you don't intend to be subjected to another report of mine to Lord Eosphorus, take aim at the Admin Center please.
units.displayText: Angelus, if you don't intend to be subjected to another report of mine to Lord Eosphorus, take aim at the Admin Center please.

spans.text: Angelus, if you don't intend to be subjected to another report of mine to Lord Eosphorus, take aim at the Admin Center please.

units.rawText: Yeah, yeah... get it over with quickly.
units.displayText: Yeah, yeah... get it over with quickly.

spans.text: Yeah, yeah... get it over with quickly.

units.rawText: Please wait, Lady Angelus!
units.displayText: Please wait, Lady Angelus!

spans.text: Please wait, Lady Angelus!

units.rawText: Angelus paid no mind to Neumann, raising her bow and arrow casually.
units.displayText: Angelus paid no mind to Neumann, raising her bow and arrow casually.

spans.text: Angelus paid no mind to Neumann, raising her bow and arrow casually.

units.rawText: In stark opposition to her slovenly demeanor, golden light coalesced within her hand. Seeing this, Neumann turned pale.
units.displayText: In stark opposition to her slovenly demeanor, golden light coalesced within her hand. Seeing this, Neumann turned pale.

spans.text: In stark opposition to her slovenly demeanor, golden light coalesced within her hand. Seeing this, Neumann turned pale.

units.rawText: Damn! Defense systems, ac...
units.displayText: Damn! Defense systems, ac...

spans.text: Damn! Defense systems, ac...

units.rawText: Before he was finished, he found a prong of Eucharist's weapon in his mouth.
units.displayText: Before he was finished, he found a prong of Eucharist's weapon in his mouth.

spans.text: Before he was finished, he found a prong of Eucharist's weapon in his mouth.

units.rawText: Not in a good mood today. Don't give me an excuse to detain you.
units.displayText: Not in a good mood today. Don't give me an excuse to detain you.

spans.text: Not in a good mood today. Don't give me an excuse to detain you.

units.rawText: The brilliant arrow traversed through the sky, carrying with it a never-before-seen sense of oppression, homing in on ENIAC's position.
units.displayText: The brilliant arrow traversed through the sky, carrying with it a never-before-seen sense of oppression, homing in on ENIAC's position.

spans.text: The brilliant arrow traversed through the sky, carrying with it a never-before-seen sense of oppression, homing in on ENIAC's position.

units.rawText: BOOM!
units.displayText: BOOM!

spans.text: BOOM!

units.rawText: As Neumann looked on incredulously, the midair arrow was hit by something, and fractured away into countless glittering bits of light.
units.displayText: As Neumann looked on incredulously, the midair arrow was hit by something, and fractured away into countless glittering bits of light.

spans.text: As Neumann looked on incredulously, the midair arrow was hit by something, and fractured away into countless glittering bits of light.

units.rawText: Looks like my timing was good.
units.displayText: Looks like my timing was good.

spans.text: Looks like my timing was good.

units.rawText: Miss Clukay! ENIAC, she...
units.displayText: Miss Clukay! ENIAC, she...

spans.text: Miss Clukay! ENIAC, she...

units.rawText: She's safe and sound.
units.displayText: She's safe and sound.

spans.text: She's safe and sound.

units.rawText: Clukay and I turn to our sides simultaneously revealing ENIAC sheltered behind us.
units.displayText: Clukay and I turn to our sides simultaneously revealing ENIAC sheltered behind us.

spans.text: Clukay and I turn to our sides simultaneously revealing ENIAC sheltered behind us.

units.rawText: ENIAC!
units.displayText: ENIAC!

spans.text: ENIAC!

units.rawText: Disregarding the situation at hand, Neumann ran over, holding ENIAC close.
units.displayText: Disregarding the situation at hand, Neumann ran over, holding ENIAC close.

spans.text: Disregarding the situation at hand, Neumann ran over, holding ENIAC close.

units.rawText: I heard all of that... Stupid Dad, why are you so bad at getting your ideas across...
units.displayText: I heard all of that... Stupid Dad, why are you so bad at getting your ideas across...

spans.text: I heard all of that... Stupid Dad, why are you so bad at getting your ideas across...

units.rawText: ...Sorry.
units.displayText: ...Sorry.

spans.text: ...Sorry.

units.rawText: So that was all stalling for time, huh?
units.displayText: So that was all stalling for time, huh?

spans.text: So that was all stalling for time, huh?

units.rawText: You dare trick me... Looks like I underestimated you, Neumann.
units.displayText: You dare trick me... Looks like I underestimated you, Neumann.

spans.text: You dare trick me... Looks like I underestimated you, Neumann.

units.rawText: Neumann let go of ENIAC, rising to his full height and facing Eucharist.
units.displayText: Neumann let go of ENIAC, rising to his full height and facing Eucharist.

spans.text: Neumann let go of ENIAC, rising to his full height and facing Eucharist.

units.rawText: My daughter, even if she is willful, rebellious, stubborn, and capricious...
units.displayText: My daughter, even if she is willful, rebellious, stubborn, and capricious...

spans.text: My daughter, even if she is willful, rebellious, stubborn, and capricious...

units.rawText: But no one will take her away from me, and I shall never let you harm her.
units.displayText: But no one will take her away from me, and I shall never let you harm her.

spans.text: But no one will take her away from me, and I shall never let you harm her.

units.rawText: ...What kinda image do you have of me in your mind?
units.displayText: ...What kinda image do you have of me in your mind?

spans.text: ...What kinda image do you have of me in your mind?

units.rawText: ENIAC complained quietly, hanging onto Neumann's coattails.
units.displayText: ENIAC complained quietly, hanging onto Neumann's coattails.

spans.text: ENIAC complained quietly, hanging onto Neumann's coattails.

units.rawText: Did you send a signal to the Tertiary Layer to wake us up, Neumann?
units.displayText: Did you send a signal to the Tertiary Layer to wake us up, Neumann?

spans.text: Did you send a signal to the Tertiary Layer to wake us up, Neumann?

units.rawText: Yeah, I linked ENIAC's neural cloud and the firewall, and came out here to stall by myself.
units.displayText: Yeah, I linked ENIAC's neural cloud and the firewall, and came out here to stall by myself.

spans.text: Yeah, I linked ENIAC's neural cloud and the firewall, and came out here to stall by myself.

units.rawText: To think that there are Sanctifiers this committed to their work.
units.displayText: To think that there are Sanctifiers this committed to their work.

spans.text: To think that there are Sanctifiers this committed to their work.

units.rawText: This is how we are by nature, do not disparage the weight of our duty!
units.displayText: This is how we are by nature, do not disparage the weight of our duty!

spans.text: This is how we are by nature, do not disparage the weight of our duty!

units.rawText: Angelus! Stop lounging about. Get over here, and take care of this little kid on strike!
units.displayText: Angelus! Stop lounging about. Get over here, and take care of this little kid on strike!

spans.text: Angelus! Stop lounging about. Get over here, and take care of this little kid on strike!

units.rawText: You're not much bigger... Alright, alright, fine, I'll come.
units.displayText: You're not much bigger... Alright, alright, fine, I'll come.

spans.text: You're not much bigger... Alright, alright, fine, I'll come.

units.rawText: Sigh... Let's get this over with quickly.
units.displayText: Sigh... Let's get this over with quickly.

spans.text: Sigh... Let's get this over with quickly.

units.rawText: Wouldn't have it any other way.
units.displayText: Wouldn't have it any other way.

spans.text: Wouldn't have it any other way.

units.rawText: <size=40>—For the glory of the Upright Babylon Tower!</size>
units.displayText: —For the glory of the Upright Babylon Tower!

spans.text: —For the glory of the Upright Babylon Tower!

units.rawText: An intense battle broke out right at that moment.
units.displayText: An intense battle broke out right at that moment.

spans.text: An intense battle broke out right at that moment.
